snippet.title: Stealth Inc: A Clone in the Dark [GAMEPLAY] - PS3
snippet.description:
Stealth Inc: A Clone in the Dark gameplay from PS3.
Stealth Inc: A Clone in the Dark gameplay without comment.
#nocommentary

Stealth Inc: A Clone in the Dark is a fun platformer that combines the features of such games as Metal Gear Solid and Super Meat Boy. We play the role of a hacker who breaks the protection in order to reach the exit. On each level we have to solve a simple riddle and remain hidden. The developers of Stealth Bastard Deluxe tried to combine elements of such different titles as Super Meat Boy and Metal Gear Solid. Thanks to this, we received a rather unusual platformer game, in which we play as a burglar and hacker. On each level, we have to avoid security systems and stay undetected. The game combines interesting logic elements and an arcade gameplay, therefore challenging both creativity and reflex of the player. In Stealth Bastard Deluxe, we have 80 levels in total. The fires few levels are very easy, but every subsequent one brings new, increasingly difficult challenges. The protagonist has to avoid opponents, watch out for the traps and security systems (such as cameras), as well as to hack various terminals.
